Class AvrRuntimeShim

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.backend.runtime.AvrRuntimeShim
public final class AvrRuntimeShim extends Object
Generates the C++ runtime shim of an AVR program, the counterpart of RuntimeShim. It reuses every shared helper block whose C is width-independent — the arena and its conservative collector, runtime strings, string builders, exceptions, the SD card and Properties, UDP, the HTTP/1.1 codec, atomics — and replaces the parts that assume a 32-bit int or a binary64 double: AVR's int is 16 bits and its double is binary32, so Java's float/double run on SoftFloatRuntime and every Arduino core function is reached through a wrapper taking Java-width parameters. The generated assembly calls all of it through the thunks AvrShimThunks appends, built from the prototypes in this very source.

RAM is the scarce resource (the ATmega4809 has 6 KB), so the pools are smaller than on the 32-bit boards: four runtime-string slots, two open SD files and Properties of eight short entries.
